newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Aug CPI up 5.5 pct yr/yr, 1.0 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Thai Aug CPI up 5.5 pct yr/yr, 1.0 pct mth/mth.

text.p: The Thai consumer price index (CPI) rose 5.5 percent year-on-year in August and 1.0 percent month-on-month, the Commerce Ministry said on Monday.
The ministry said the 1990-based index rose 5.5 percent year-on-year in August to 134.8, up from its 127.8 level in August 1995.
The 1.0 percent month-on-month increase compared to a 0.2 percent increase in July over June, the ministry said.
The index rose 5.4 percent year-on-year in July.
The Thai Commerce Ministry issued the following economic indicators:
THAI CONSUMER PRICES Aug 96 July 96 Aug 95

NOTES: In the food and beverage category, vegetables and fruit prices surged 11.0 percent in August from July after five straight months of decline. Meat, poultry and seafood prices rose 2.2 percent, eggs and dairy products increased 1.2 percent, and prepared food prices rose 0.9 percent. Non-alchoholic products fell 0.1 percent.

In the non-food group, costs of entertainment, reading materials, and education expenses remained steady, while transport and communications expenses fell 0.2 percent and cost of maintenance checks and other personal services rose 0.2 percent.
